{{Quote|Grand Moff Vaiken was eventully killed during an Imperial campaign to conquer an alien system in deep space. He died in battle of the bridge of a prototype Star Destroyer. A fitting end to the first Imperial Grand Moff.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="Timeline 11" />}}
This '''campaign''' was the last one overseen by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] against an unidentified alien civilization. He was killed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the conflict.<ref name="Timeline 11" />
